# Jubilees Chapter 32 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 32:1 — "pillar" vs. "standing stone"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "anoint the pillar" | Traditional rendering following "massebah" |
| LOGOS | "anointed the standing stone" | Consistent with ch.27 consensus on massebah |
| PNEUMA | "set up the stone" | Compresses; drops the anointing back-reference |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "standing stone" for consistency with the ch.27 ruling. PNEUMA's compression loses the connection between the anointing vow and this divine command to return.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 32:7 — the Levi-as-tenth mechanism

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the lot fell upon Levi, for the number ten was the number which fell" | Literal two-clause explanation |
| LOGOS | "the lot came to Levi, for ten was the number that fell" | Condensed formal |
| PNEUMA | "the tenth position fell to Levi. That was the lot" | Reordered dynamically |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS. The mechanism (counting to ten twice, Levi being the tenth) is explained in the Ge'ez in a somewhat repetitive way that Jubilees apparently intends as legally precise. LOGOS preserves both clauses without EMET's awkward repetition.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 32:22 — etymology of Benjamin

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "son of the days — that is, the son of his old age" | Preserves both the etymological name and its explanation |
| LOGOS | "son of the days, that is, son of his old age" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "'son of his old age,' is what the name means" | Loses "son of the days" which is the actual Ge'ez name |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET/LOGOS "son of the days — that is, son of his old age." The Ge'ez name explanation must be preserved; PNEUMA's rendering drops the literal name meaning.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---
